# Voice Echoes: A Critical Review and Future Research Agenda on the Consequences of Employee Voice for Voicers, their Co-workers, and Managers

<!-- generated by scripts/generate_topic_pages.py -->

← Back to topic

**Authors:** Karolina W. Nieberle, Martin P. Fladerer  
**Year:** 2025  
**Journal:** Human Relations  
**DOI:** [10.1177/20413866251317929](https://doi.org/10.1177/20413866251317929)  
**Publisher:** [https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/10.1177/20413866251317929](https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/10.1177/20413866251317929)

**Keywords:** employee voice, voice consequences, critical review, co-workers, managers, voice behavior

## Abstract

A critical review examining the multi-level consequences of employee voice, analyzing how voice affects not only the voicers themselves but also their co-workers and managers, with a proposed future research agenda.
